choices: total is declared inside the loop, so it no longer exists at the println
total must be initialised to 0 before the loop
i cannot be used to set total
println cannot print an int variable
explanation: A variable exists only inside the block that declares it. total is created and destroyed on every pass of the loop, so by the time the println runs there is no such name. If it has to outlive the loop, declare it before the loop - which is also the only way it could accumulate anything across iterations.
